_readme: ASSUMPTIONS: the only inputs in PM-OS that are not observed market data. Edit freely; every tool echoes the values it used.

tax._source: Assumed top-bracket client. Federal ordinary 37% + 3.8% NIIT; long-term capital gains 20% + 3.8% NIIT.

strategies._source: Duration bands paraphrased from public descriptions of fixed income SMA strategies; sector caps and rating floor are ASSUMED mandate limits.

intermediate_muni.label: Fidelity Intermediate Municipal Income Fund (public N-PORT filing)
intermediate_muni._verified_from: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/215829/000021582926000017/filing10988.htm (497K for this fund, filed under CIK 215829)

limited_term_muni.label: Fidelity Limited Term Municipal Income Fund (public N-PORT filing)

sma_sample._source: SMA sizing assumption: real bonds, prices and yields; par per bond is set to equal-weight odd lots.

cost_basis._source: Funds do not publish lot-level cost. Default: the bond's price in an N-PORT filing ~1 year earlier, or a user upload in data/user/overrides.csv.
